question: Which among the following Indian Olympians is associated with wrestling sport?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Sakshi Malik.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Sakshi Malik** won a** bronze medal** in **wrestling **at the **2016 Rio Olympics.**
 
• **Neeraj Chopra** is associated with **Javelin throw** and won a **gold medal** in the same event at the **2020 Tokyo Olympics.**
 
• **Abhinav Bindra** is associated with **shooting **and won a** gold medal** in the **10m Air Rifle event **at the **2008 Beijing Olympics.**
 
• **Aditi Ashok** is associated with **golf **and represented India in the **women's individual event** at the **2016 Rio Olympics.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Wrestling** is a **popular sport **in India and has a **rich history.**
 
• It is believed to have originated in the** Indus Valley Civilization** around** 5000 years** ago.
 
• India has produced many legendary wrestlers in the past, including the likes of **Dara Singh, Sushil Kumar, and Yogeshwar Dutt.**
 
• Wrestling is also a part of the ancient** Indian martial art** form known as **Kushti.**
 
• The Indian wrestling team has won several medals at international events such as the** Olympics, Commonwealth Games, and Asian Games.**
